db2f3f7641ec8838b45c73941406e129efebd626: La Giettaz is a modest, low-key resort — 20 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where you come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. La Giettaz's reputation as a family resort is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. La Giettaz's altitude (1123 m at the base, 2440 m at the top) helps it maintain decent snow cover in the middle of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The budget for a stay in La Giettaz is clearly high: €52 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence — but you should be aware of it before you set off. In short: La Giettaz is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincere family atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It is hard to have a bad stay here.
